deploy-bot: Release rc2 (2025-03-15) paused by security gate — SBOM provenance check failed for base image :warning:

alex.k: ugh. which image?

maria-r: looks like `gcr.io/redwood/base:2025-03-01` didn't have signed provenance in our SBOM registry. SBOM link: https://sbom.internal/redwood/rc2/metadata

sec-eng: confirmed. the provenance signature step timed out during image build, so the SBOM entry is incomplete. policy requires signed provenance for public-facing releases.

qa: can we still canary? current canary cluster shows 3/5 pods healthy, but deploybot forced hold.

deploy-bot: Canary halted. 3/5 -> rollback not triggered because user requested canary keep, but security gate overrides.

sam: option A: quarantine this image and pin to last-known-good digest `gcr.io/redwood/base@sha256:4ab3f9...` and continue rollout. Option B: rebuild image with signed provenance (takes ~30m) and re-run SBOM.

alex.k: pin sounds fastest. what's the rollback impact?

maria-r: pinning to digest keeps app layer identical; only base image changes. we need security approval for exception to allow digest pin instead of full provenance fix.

sec-eng: we can grant temporary exception if we get compensating controls: 1) block external network egress for the canary, 2) add runtime detection rule for 48h, 3) ticket to rebuild with signed provenance within 24h. If those met, approve pin.

jamie: created ticket INFRA-4821 to rebuild base with provenance, assigned to infra. ETA 18h.

qa: adding runtime detection rule: `sig_id:SBOM_PROVENANCE_MISSING` alert -> pager only if >5 occurrences in 10m.

alex.k: @sec-eng please approve exception so deploybot can resume. also adding release note: "Temporarily pinned base image for rc2 due to SBOM provenance signature timeout; rebuild in progress."

sec-eng: approved with controls in place. :lock:

deploy-bot: Exception recorded. Resuming canary rollout. pinned digest `gcr.io/redwood/base@sha256:4ab3f9...`. Canaries 3/5 -> 5/5 after restart.

maria-r: will follow up with postmortem on build signing step and add retry/alert on provenance publish.

sam: thanks. I'll watch INFRA-4821 and coordinate the rebuild.

alex.k: copying this to release notes doc and tagging legal for compliance sign-off.

deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot: release resumed under security exception record 2025-03-15-EXC-07."
